metadata.method: GNU objdump decoding within PE .pdata ranges or directly verified trivial leaf functions; exact public-symbol lookup
limitations: Includes public dispatch symbols and, when present, the verified LegacyClientNetworkHandler vtable entries in the input manifest.
Missing public symbols do not mean a packet is unhandled.
Client vtable entries describe that dispatch route; alternate listeners are not resolved.
Direct targets may be wrappers; indirect/virtual/CFG calls remain unresolved.
No recursive control-flow analysis, runtime testing, or behavioral parity claim.
Possible tail calls and external jumps are recorded separately.

handlers.boundary_evidence: Single RET instruction directly verified; no unwind range needed.
